title: SM-16.04 - EUSurvey transition timeline for external users
intent: This article answers: SM-16.04 - EUSurvey transition timeline for external users
short_answer: The main transition milestones are 31 August 2026 for the restriction on new survey creation by external users, September 2026 to March 2027 for migration and support, 1 April 2027 for read-only mode, and 1 September 2027 for final closure.
important_conditions: During read-only mode, surveys cannot be edited and no new responses can be collected.
Survey data remains available for viewing and export until final closure.
Users should export data or transfer ownership before the applicable deadlines.
